headline: Thornblade Build
title: Thornblade Build | Sword Dance Crit Damage | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Thornblade is a Grass melee damage dealer built around its Sword Dance trait. Every skill you use adds a stack, up to four, and each basic attack spends one stack for one hundred eighty percent extra damage. Run Thorny Defense and Thorny Impact, both of which raise your crit rate. Put attack first in your stat priority. Do you main Thornblade? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Four stacks, spend one per basic attack
